summary: Full frontend testing of 'A Returned Spirit - Tavern Crafting RPG'. All 5 screens tested via Playwright on mobile viewport (375x667). All core flows working correctly.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated, use style.pointerEvents (non-blocking, cosmetic only)

critical_code_review_comments: load-game.tsx: handleDelete does not show Alert confirmation before deleting — data is lost immediately without warning
support.tsx: 'Send message' is local-only (setSent=true) — no actual backend/network call. If this is intentional, it's fine; otherwise needs implementation
seed_data_creation: Created save slot 'Aria' in slot 1 via AsyncStorage during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All screens verified working: main menu (4 buttons + version text), new-game (3 slots, modal, character name save), load-game (shows saved slot 'Aria' with delete button), settings (music/sfx volume toggles, vibration modes all working, persists to AsyncStorage), support (message form + success state). 10% opacity background image working on all sub-screens. Oldenburg font renders correctly. Navigation (back button) works on all screens.
